content.text: Structured answers need a different stored shape from ordinary repeat answers: each structured question holds its rows inside one typed value. I’m adding that path and checking which existing validators can run before the action writes to the form.

content.text:
You were right about the date handling: parsing a date with `new Date(...)` can shift its calendar day in some time zones, and the datetime branch accepts date-only strings. I’m separating those checks; the existing time format is correct.

The diagnosis and symptom checks use the same duplicate-code rule. Both manual entry and fill actions will now reuse one small helper.

The local backend cannot start because its virtual environment is missing Django, so the browser checks used mocked clinical responses.

Updated [useFillActions.ts](/Users/bodhishthomas/code/care_fe/src/components/QuestionnaireV2/fill/useFillActions.ts):

- Added structured JSON answers with existing validators.
- Shared diagnosis/symptom duplicate checks with manual entry.
- Fixed date timezone shifts and invalid-date acceptance. Datetime requires both date and time; time remains `HH:mm[:ss]`.

Verified: 97 unit tests, 4 browser tests, TypeScript, and formatting pass. Lint has only two existing warnings.

Browser tests used mocked responses; backend testing was unavailable because Django is missing locally.
I’ll commit the fill-action changes and push the current branch.
